Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser

Class BrowserStore

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.BrowserStore
public final class BrowserStore extends Object
JSON persistence for the web browser: the BrowserSettings, the bookmarks, the history, the downloads and the open-tab session (a list of URLs restored on next launch).

Configuration lives under ~/.lg3d/webbrowser/ by default; override with the system property DIR_PROPERTY (tests point it at a temp folder, or construct the store with an explicit Path). Every read is defensive: a missing, empty or corrupt file yields the empty/default value and is logged, never thrown, so a damaged profile can never stop the browser from opening.

This class holds no AWT or JavaFX references and does no rendering, so it exercises identically in a headless unit test and in the desktop.
